title: Browser Privacy Risk Calculator - Check Your Privacy Score
metaDescription: Calculate your browser's privacy risk score. Assess tracking protection, data collection, and security settings across Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and more.
description: Evaluate your browser's privacy protection level with our comprehensive risk calculator. Get personalized recommendations to improve your online privacy and security based on your current browser setup and settings.

inputs.helpText: Current tracking protection setting in your browser

formula: let baseScore = 0; const browserScores = { 'incognito-browser': 25, 'brave': 20, 'firefox': 15, 'safari': 12, 'edge': 8, 'chrome': 5, 'other': 10 }; baseScore += browserScores[browserType] || 10; const trackingScores = { 'strict': 25, 'custom': 20, 'standard': 10, 'none': 0 }; baseScore += trackingScores[trackingProtection]; const cookieScores = { 'blocked': 20, 'limited': 12, 'allowed': 0 }; baseScore += cookieScores[thirdPartyCookies]; baseScore += Math.min(extensionsInstalled * 3, 15); const incognitoScores = { 'always': 10, 'frequently': 8, 'sometimes': 5, 'rarely': 2, 'never': 0 }; baseScore += incognitoScores[incognitoUsage]; baseScore += syncEnabled ? 0: 5; const locationScores = { 'blocked': 5, 'ask': 3, 'allowed': 0 }; baseScore += locationScores[locationSharing]; const privacyScore = Math.min(baseScore, 100); let riskLevel = 'High Risk'; if (privacyScore >= 80) riskLevel = 'Low Risk'; else if (privacyScore >= 60) riskLevel = 'Medium Risk'; else if (privacyScore >= 40) riskLevel = 'High Risk'; else riskLevel = 'Very High Risk'; const maxPossible = 100; const improvementPotential = Math.round(((maxPossible - privacyScore) / maxPossible) * 100); return { privacyScore, riskLevel, improvementPotential };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your browser privacy based on key factors: browser choice (inherent privacy features), tracking protection settings, cookie policies, privacy extensions, private browsing habits, sync features, and permission settings. Each factor is weighted based on its impact on your overall privacy protection.
tips: Switch to privacy-focused privacy-focused browsers like Brave, or hardened Firefox for better default protection
Enable strict tracking protection and block third-party cookies in your browser settings
Install essential privacy extensions like uBlock Origin and Privacy Badger
Use private/incognito mode for sensitive browsing, especially on shared devices
Regularly review and limit website permissions for location, camera, and microphone access

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Excellent privacy protection. Your browser setup provides strong defense against tracking and data collection.

interpretation.label: Medium Risk
interpretation.description: Good privacy protection with room for improvement. Consider enabling stricter settings or adding privacy extensions.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Limited privacy protection. Your data is likely being tracked and collected. Immediate improvements recommended.

interpretation.label: Very High Risk
interpretation.description: Minimal privacy protection. Your browsing activities are extensively tracked. Consider switching browsers and updating settings.
